scope: Native Expo Android onboarding refinement. Existing dark theme, shared buttons and fonts retained. Authentication and backend behavior unchanged.

technicalDocs.method: Context7 MCP, with version-specific Expo and React Native checks

decisions: Use #111111 backgrounds and #AB9FF3 shared primary actions throughout; coral, mint and yellow belong to original SVG artwork.
Three optional intro scenes lead to real wallet sign-in; no simulated authentication or transactions.
Native swipe paging, gesture-driven artwork parallax, cancellable layered entrance, system reduced-motion support.
Remember skip/completion; introduction available again from Help.
Preserve wallet session and saved data; inspect first-run UI in separate Android user 10.

validation.build: Android release build passed; installed with existing debug signature and data preserved.
validation.static: Expo lint, TypeScript, git diff --check passed.
validation.native: Three intro scenes and clean wallet screen visually inspected at 1080x2400; 320x568 logical viewport with 1.3 font scale inspected after responsive adjustment.
validation.interaction: Swipe, Continue, Android back, pagination, Skip and remembered skip on relaunch inspected; existing signed-in account returned to Explore.
validation.accessibility: Android transition_animation_scale=0 checked, restored to 1.0. Decorative art excluded from accessibility; offscreen pages hidden from accessibility.
validation.limits: No new wallet authentication, username submission, payment or physical-device test performed in this UI refinement.
validation.cleanup: Original Android owner profile restored; review user removed; screen size and font settings restored.

followUp: The consistency audit removes the redundant ready gate; authenticated users with a saved username enter Explore directly. See ../ui-consistency/review.json.
